steps.description: This is the step that answers the research question. steps.description: Assemble a single report from T1S1, T1S2, T2S1 and T2S2. sample_01's depth and the keep/drop decision appear in the report

plan.title: Footprint pathway + TF activity, cytokine vs vehicle
plan.analytical_narrative:
The question asks which signaling pathways are active in the cytokine-stimulated bronchial epithelial samples relative to vehicle, judged by the transcriptional footprint rather than by expression of pathway members. That is exactly the PROGENy footprint model, run through decoupleR, with a CollecTRI TF-activity inference as the regulator-level companion; both are footprint inferences from a prior network, not membership enrichment. The dataset is 12000 genes x 12 samples (6 cytokine-stimulated vs 6 vehicle), raw gene-level Salmon counts keyed by gene symbol, single batch, unpaired — small enough that everything runs in minutes on modest resources, and small enough that a network inferred from the data itself (ARACNe/WGCNA-style) would be noise, so prior-knowledge networks are the only sound source (R-0121, R-0140).

The stated caveat drives step T1S1: sample_01 has a library size about 4x below the median. It is kept, not silently dropped — inspected on the blind-VST PCA and the sample-distance heatmap, its library size and detected-gene count reported beside the others (R-0008). DESeq2 size factors already down-weight depth, so depth alone is not a removal criterion (R-0030); removal happens only with a stated reason recorded in the QC output, and if it happens, downstream steps re-run on the reduced set and say so.

T1S2 fits the gene-level model whose per-gene Wald statistic is the input the activity inference wants: minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size), design ~condition with the vehicle/control level set explicitly as the reference so a positive log2FC means higher in the cytokine-stimulated arm, DESeq2 Wald, apeglm shrinkage for reporting, BH at alpha 0.05. Differential expression here is instrumental — the contrast statistic feeds T2S1 and T2S2 — but the table is also reported because a footprint score has to be readable against the genes that produced it.

T2S1 is the answer to the research question: decoupleR mlm on the human PROGENy weights (14 pathways, top 500 responsive genes per pathway) applied to the full vector of Wald statistics, plus a per-sample score matrix on log2-CPM for the picture, tested between arms with limma and BH across pathways. Topology-aware impact analysis (SPIA) is not available in this environment, and the report must say the footprint uses no pathway graph topology (R-0122). T2S2 adds regulator-level resolution with decoupleR ulm on the CollecTRI human regulons, signed edges kept, min regulon size 5, per-sample scores tested with limma and BH across regulators. T3S1 assembles both activity tables with the required provenance — network name and version, input statistic, contrast, estimator, minimum regulon size, number of pathways/regulators tested — and states plainly that an activity score is an inference from a prior network and a hypothesis for follow-up, not a measurement.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes
Minimal pre-filter: at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples
DESeq2 design ~condition with explicit reference level control
DESeq2 Wald test, treated vs control (Wald statistic used as the activity input)
Pathway activity with decoupleR mlm on the PROGENy footprint model
Transcription factor activity with decoupleR ulm on the CollecTRI regulons
Activity report with network version, statistic, estimator, regulator counts, inference caution, and reproducibility record

steps.description: Assemble a single report from T1S1, T1S2, T2S1 and T2S2. Lead with the PROGENy pathway result — the pathways whose footprint moves in cytokine-stimulated versus vehicle bronchial epithelium, with effect direction, adjusted p-value and responsive-gene coverage — then the corroborating CollecTRI TF activities, then the gene-level contrast as supporting detail. For every activity result state: network name and version (PROGENy human / CollecTRI human, with the reference-store version string), the input statistic (DESeq2 Wald, contrast cytokine-stimulated vs vehicle), the estimator (mlm / ulm), the minimum regulon or responsive-set size, and the number of pathways and regulators tested. State in plain terms that an activity score is an inference from a prior network and a hypothesis for follow-up, not a measurement, and that no pathway-graph topology entered any score. Carry forward the sample_01 depth finding and the keep/drop decision. Include a reproducibility record: sessionInfo, the random seed, package versions, and the version of every reference collection used.
steps.context: Both headline results are network inferences on the same contrast statistic; the report must not present them as two independent lines of evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Report names, for each activity result, the network and version, input statistic, contrast direction, estimator, minimum set size, and the number of pathways/regulators tested
The footprint-not-membership interpretation and the absence of topology are stated explicitly
sample_01's depth and the keep/drop decision appear in the report
Shared-input dependence between the PROGENy and CollecTRI results is stated
Reproducibility record included: sessionInfo, seed, package versions, reference collection versions
No pathway is claimed as active on an unadjusted p-value alone
constraints: Do not upgrade an inferred activity score to a claim of measured pathway activation
Do not present the TF result as independent confirmation of the pathway result
Report adjusted p-values throughout; state the cutoff used
caveats: 12 samples give limited power for the per-sample limma test on scores; a null result is weak evidence of absence and should be stated as such
If sample_01 was retained, note that its depth inflates the variance of its per-sample scores

grounding.reason: R-0119 fixes the required provenance fields and the inference caution for an activity report; R-0086 fixes the reproducibility record.
